title_original: 중국산 폴리(에틸렌 테레프탈레이트)에 대한 덤핑방지관세 부과에 관한 규칙
full_text:
ADDENDA <No. 1090, November 29, 2024>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date) These Rules shall enter into force on November 30, 2024.

Article 2 (Period of Validity) These Rules shall remain in force for five years from the date of their promulgation.

Article 3 (Applicability to Goods Subject to Provisional Measures) These Rules shall apply to goods for which import declarations were filed on or after July 30, 2024.
